user.title: Connect to Roomba
user.description: Enter the robot BLID and local MQTT password. Host/IP is optional; when omitted the integration uses mDNS hostname iRobot-<BLID>.local.

data_description.password: Local MQTT password for the robot.
data_description.host: Robot IP or hostname on your LAN. Leave blank to resolve via mDNS.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the robot over local MQTT (TLS port 8883). See Home Assistant logs for the classified failure detail.
error.dns_error: Hostname/mDNS lookup failed. Enter the robot's LAN IP in Host, or fix mDNS from the Home Assistant host.
error.unreachable: TCP port 8883 is unreachable from this Home Assistant host. If scripts on another VM work, check HA OS/container networking, VLANs, and firewall on the hypervisor — this is not a TLS/password problem.
error.tls_error: Reached the robot but the TLS handshake failed. The robot needs legacy OpenSSL settings (AES128-SHA256, SECLEVEL=0, legacy renegotiation). Update this integration; do not treat this as a wrong IP.
error.auth_invalid: Robot rejected MQTT username/password (BLID / local password). TCP and TLS succeeded.
error.mqtt_protocol: Robot rejected the MQTT protocol or client id after TLS succeeded.
error.mqtt_timeout: TCP is reachable but MQTT CONNACK timed out. The robot may be busy or dropping the TLS/MQTT session.

fetch_map.title: Fetch cloud map
fetch_map.description: Enter your iRobot account email and password for this refresh only. Credentials and cloud tokens are discarded after the map is saved. Robot …{blid_suffix}.

data_description.email: Used once to authorize map download; not stored in the config entry.
data_description.password: Used once for this fetch; never saved.
data_description.country: Two-letter country code for cloud endpoint discovery (default US).

error.map_fetch_failed: Could not log in or download the map. Check account credentials and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while fetching the map.
